why: Klartag (arXiv:2504.05042, Apr 2025) proved a new asymptotic lower bound on sphere packing density in general dimension n, improving the order of magnitude of the best known lower bound by a factor of n; separately, an AI-assisted SDP approach (arXiv:2512.04829, 2025) reports new state-of-the-art upper bounds on packing density in dimensions 4-16, surpassing prior linear-programming bounds.
